remarks: Don't miss the opportunity to own this amazing 2-family home in the highly sought-after Springdale section of Stamford! Generating a strong $61,000 annual rent roll, this corner lot property sits on 0.13 acres and boasts excellent curb appeal with a new Trex deck, underground irrigation system, and a fenced backyard. The first-floor unit features 3 bedrooms and exclusive access to a fully finished basement, perfect for additional living or storage space. Inside, tenants enjoy hardwood floors, granite countertops, and modern finishes. The second-floor unit offers 2 well-sized bedrooms, completing this highly desirable multi-family setup. With plenty of off-street parking, a prime commuter-friendly location-just 1 mile to Springdale train station and a 3-minute walk to the bus line-this property is an investor's dream. Don't miss out on this turn-key asset in one of Stamford's most in-demand rental markets! Schedule your showing today!
